assumptions: Original infinite-temperature interacting dephasing chain, t=1, U in[3.9,4.1], physical d in[1.9,2.1], V in[0,3]. Source reports a six-spin Ramsey contrast and uniform actual-model GLOBAL regret <8.7804e-5 at262144 independent shots or <4.3428e-5 at1048576 shots, with >99% probability under acquired model/bias/actuator assumptions.
